nodes.label: TPBench: Theoretical Physics Benchmark
nodes.author: Daniel J H Chung, Zhiqi Gao, Yurii Kvasiuk, Tianyi Li, Moritz Münchmeyer, Maja Rudolph, Frederic Sala, Sai Chaitanya Tadepalli
nodes.rationale: 57 novel TP problems (undergrad to research level) spanning high-energy theory, cosmology, general relativity. Auto-verifiable via Python callables. Evaluates reasoning beyond memorization.

nodes.label: TPBench Difficulty Levels
nodes.rationale: L1 easy undergrad (8, 14%), L2 undergrad (13, 22.8%), L3 easy grad (11, 19.3%), L4 grad/easy research (14, 24.6%), L5 research (11, 19.3%). Research problems are sub-publication-level steps.

nodes.label: Auto-Verification System (TPBench)
nodes.rationale: Python callable extraction, test-case execution, numerical comparison with tolerances. Handles algebraic equivalence (e.g., 2x+2 ≡ 2(x+1)). Excludes tensor/manifold expressions due to equivalence complexity.

nodes.label: AI-Based Holistic Grading (TPBench)
nodes.rationale: Letter grades A–D based on reasoning quality and correctness. GPT-4o grader shows strong correlation with auto-verification (A: 82.2% correct) but unreliable at L4–L5 due to complexity.

nodes.label: TPBench Failure Mode Analysis
nodes.rationale: Background knowledge retrieval (strong), algebraic mistakes (frequent), logical errors (theorem misapplication), hallucinations (invented rules). o-series models rely on literature memory rather than step-by-step calculation.
